study_design: Randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled Phase IIa; 60 mg once daily arm n=18 versus placebo n=17; FVC was a secondary endpoint at 12 weeks.
limitations: Small exploratory Phase IIa sample and short follow-up. Arms had wide confidence intervals; this outcome compares the molecule with placebo and cannot identify any causal effect of AI on efficacy or development speed.
